---
title: "Blood products — model fitting"
format: html
---

- Prespecified: adjusted model for all blood products. All other models, including the zero-inflated ones, are additional.
- `ns(x, df = 2)` has three knots (minimum, median, maximum), the flexibility of the SAP's three-knot restricted cubic spline; the SAP gives no knot positions.
- ECOG in four categories, as in the other count models; the two ECOG terms in the SAP's formula are an error.
- Creatinine on the log scale (SAP: original scale): on the original scale, one patient's extreme value dominated the extreme draws of the marginal rates.
- No adjusted thrombocyte model: no thrombocyte transfusions at ECOG 3+; with normal(0, 10) priors, the 95% CrI of its rate ratio was 0.0008 to 567.
- No zero-inflated thrombocyte model: sampling of the adjusted model had not finished after more than two hours.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "07-blood-products", "results")

blood_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"))
completed_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
```

## Priors

```{r}
#| label: priors

coefficient_prior <- prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b")

# For models whose chains drift to the Poisson limit (shape -> infinity) with the
# default shape prior, also after the refit.
gamma_shape_prior <- c(coefficient_prior, prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape"))

zi_prior <- c(coefficient_prior, prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b", dpar = "zi"))
```

## Convergence rule

```{r}
#| label: convergence-rule

thresholds <- config$diagnostics

fit_diagnostics <- function(fit) {
  draw_summary <- summarise_draws(fit, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  nuts <- nuts_params(fit)
  max_treedepth <- control_params(fit)$max_treedepth

  tibble(
    iterations = fit$fit@sim$iter,
    max_rhat = max(draw_summary$rhat),
    min_ess_bulk = min(draw_summary$ess_bulk),
    min_ess_tail = min(draw_summary$ess_tail),
    divergences = sum(nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
    treedepth_hits = sum(
      nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= max_treedepth
    ),
    min_bfmi = min(rstan::get_bfmi(fit$fit))
  )
}

passes_thresholds <- function(diagnostics) {
  with(diagnostics, coalesce(
    max_rhat <= thresholds$max_rhat &
      min_ess_bulk >= thresholds$min_ess_bulk &
      min_ess_tail >= thresholds$min_ess_tail &
      divergences <= thresholds$max_divergent_transitions &
      treedepth_hits <= thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded &
      min_bfmi >= thresholds$min_bfmi,
    FALSE
  ))
}

refit_unconverged <- function(fits, seed) {
  imap(fits, \(fit, index) {
    if (passes_thresholds(fit_diagnostics(fit))) {
      return(fit)
    }
    update(fit, iter = 4000L, seed = seed + 500000L + index, refresh = 0L)
  })
}
```

## All blood products

```{r}
#| label: fit-blood-products

blood_products_adjusted_path <- file.path(results_dir, "model-blood_products-adjusted.rds")
blood_products_unadjusted_path <- file.path(results_dir, "model-blood_products-unadjusted.rds")

if (!file.exists(blood_products_adjusted_path)) {
  # brm_multiple() seeds only compilation; seed R's RNG for the Stan seeds.
  set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + 2401L)

  blood_products_adjusted_fits <- brm_multiple(
    bf(
      n_blood_products ~ tx + splines::ns(hemoglobin, df = 2) +
        splines::ns(platelet_count, df = 2) + splines::ns(age, df = 2) +
        splines::ns(log(creatinine), df = 2) + ecog_group +
        offset(log(exposure_days))
    ),
    data = completed_datasets,
    family = negbinomial(),
    prior = gamma_shape_prior,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    cores = 1L,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2401L,
    combine = FALSE,
    refresh = 0L
  )

  blood_products_adjusted_fits <- refit_unconverged(
    blood_products_adjusted_fits,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2401L
  )

  saveRDS(blood_products_adjusted_fits, blood_products_adjusted_path, compress = "xz")
}

if (!file.exists(blood_products_unadjusted_path)) {
  blood_products_unadjusted_fits <- list(brm(
    bf(n_blood_products ~ tx + offset(log(exposure_days))),
    data = blood_data,
    family = negbinomial(),
    prior = coefficient_prior,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    cores = 1L,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2402L,
    refresh = 0L
  ))

  blood_products_unadjusted_fits <- refit_unconverged(
    blood_products_unadjusted_fits,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2402L
  )

  saveRDS(blood_products_unadjusted_fits, blood_products_unadjusted_path, compress = "xz")
}

blood_products_adjusted_fits <- readRDS(blood_products_adjusted_path)
blood_products_unadjusted_fits <- readRDS(blood_products_unadjusted_path)
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: model-diagnostics

blood_diagnostics <- list(
  "All blood products, adjusted" = blood_products_adjusted_fits,
  "All blood products, unadjusted" = blood_products_unadjusted_fits,
  "Erythrocytes, adjusted" = erythrocytes_adjusted_fits,
  "Erythrocytes, unadjusted" = erythrocytes_unadjusted_fits,
  "Thrombocytes, unadjusted" = thrombocytes_unadjusted_fits,
  "All blood products, zero-inflated, adjusted" = zi_blood_products_adjusted_fits,
  "All blood products, zero-inflated, unadjusted" = zi_blood_products_unadjusted_fits,
  "Erythrocytes, zero-inflated, adjusted" = zi_erythrocytes_adjusted_fits,
  "Erythrocytes, zero-inflated, unadjusted" = zi_erythrocytes_unadjusted_fits
) |>
  map(\(fits) list_rbind(map(fits, fit_diagnostics), names_to = "imputation")) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "model") |>
  mutate(passed = passes_thresholds(pick(everything())))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics per model and imputation"

kable(blood_diagnostics, digits = 3)
```

- Fits passing every threshold: `r sum(blood_diagnostics$passed)` of `r nrow(blood_diagnostics)`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-combined-coefficients
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior coefficients of the adjusted combined blood-product model (first imputation)"

blood_products_adjusted_fits[[1]] |>
  fixef() |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
